segments.text: Hello, my name is Emma Walsh. I work in digital marketing, mostly for sports and community organizations.
I am applying for a digital marketing role in soccer.
I have around four years in digital marketing.
I have worked with a local sports club, a small online shop and a charity.
I managed social media, newsletters and some paid ads.
To grow the brand online, create good content, run campaigns, talk to the community and report the results to the club.
I look at who is already engaging with us and who we want to reach.
Then I focus on the groups that are the most valuable, like parents and young players.
I start with what the audience likes, then plan the content in a calendar.
I create it, someone approves it, and I publish it on the right channels.
Afterwards I check how it performed.
It depends on the goal and the budget.
Organic is good for community, paid for fast reach, email for people who already know us.
I try a mix and see what works.
I check the numbers to see where people drop off.
Then I change the simplest thing first, like the message or the image, and test again.
I listen to everyone, then prioritize by what helps the main goal.
If I cannot do everything, I explain why and agree on a timeline.
Strong passwords, limited access, and permission from parents before using photos of children.
I also keep a backup plan so the work continues if I am away.
I follow newsletters and some industry accounts, and I try new tools in small tests.
If it saves time or improves results, we keep it.
Once I scheduled a post with the wrong date for an event.
A parent pointed it out, I corrected it quickly and apologized.
Now I always have a second person check important posts.
Thank you for the opportunity.
